description: Count vehicles registered in California from official DMV data, broken down by ZIP code, make, model year, fuel type or light/heavy duty. Each row is a count of registered vehicles from the California DMV "Vehicle Fuel Type Count by Zip Code" file, with annual snapshots back to 2019, so it answers "how many vehicles are registered in ZIP 90210", "how many Toyotas are registered in California", or "how many 2024-model-year vehicles are on California roads". For electric-vehicle share of the fleet use ca_dmv_ev_adoption; for a DMV office address use ca_dmv_offices.

fuel_type.description: Fuel/drivetrain; plain words are mapped to California's labels, e.g. "electric", "diesel", "gas", "hybrid", "plug-in hybrid", "hydrogen".

group_by.description: Breakdown dimension: fuel (default), zip, make, model_year, duty.

make.description: Vehicle make, matched as a substring, e.g. "TESLA", "FORD".

year.description: Snapshot year, 2019–2026. Defaults to 2026 (the most recent).

name: ca_dmv_vehicle_registrations
title: Ca Dmv Vehicle Registrations
